[color=#D4D4D8]
The Reaper [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]is a scythe-wielding shadow fighter who harvests souls from defeated enemies. Souls increase her damage and speed, and can also protect the Farmer through Death’s Bargain. Her ultimate, Soul Rend, consumes all stored souls in a massive area burst.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
The Frost Mage[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8] controls the battlefield with Chill, Frost, and Freeze stacks. Frozen enemies can shatter into nearby targets, creating chain reactions across enemy packs. Absolute Zero gives the Farmer a brief invulnerable channel before releasing a huge freezing explosion.
The Samurai [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]is a fast crit-based finisher class. She builds Ken stacks, dashes into battle, and unleashes powerful Iaijutsu strikes. With Zanshin and Void State, she can turn perfect timing into devastating burst damage.
The Gunslinger[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]brings dual pistols, chamber management, reload windows, Hot Stacks, ricochets, Cherry Bombs, and Dead Man’s Volley. The longer she keeps firing, the more dangerous her bullet storm becomes.
The Rogue[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]is the special new highlight: a fast single-pistol class focused on debuffs, executions, and gold stealing. Her shots apply Vulnerability, making enemies take more damage from all companions. She can also steal gold directly from monsters, complete with coin VFX, custom sounds, jackpot effects, and powerful Phantom upgrades. She is both a support damage dealer and a true gold-farming combat class.[/color]
